probe.meaning:
Joint-only scripted grasp/transport feasibility probe; not a learned policy.

Commands bounded humanoid joint PD targets only. The guitar is free, contacts
and the passive strap remain the existing environment's physics.

metric_meaning.grip_transport_distance_m: Episode-best position-error improvement credited only during eligible contact after first acquisition; not net displacement from reset
